characterList.description: A woman with gray hair, wearing a black jacket and a pink scarf. She is sitting in a chair and speaking at a UN conference.
characterList.name: Claire Edwards

characterList.description: A man with gray hair, wearing a dark suit and a blue tie. He is sitting at a table on a raised platform, listening to Claire Edwards and responding to her. He is the UN Secretary-General.
characterList.name: Antonio Guterres

content_metadata.description: An analysis of a video presentation addressing electromagnetic radiation exposure at the United Nations' Vienna International Center. The video features a discussion between Claire Edwards and UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres.

qAndA.question: What specific year does Claire Edwards mention as the time when Wi-Fi boosters and cell phone boosters were installed in the UN buildings without informing staff?
How does Claire Edwards describe the levels of electromagnetic radiation (EMF) to which UN staff have been exposed?
What type of building does Claire Edwards mention exacerbates the EMF situation?

qAndA.answer: The video states that they have "greatly stepped up its lobbying, interference and subversion".
qAndA.question: According to the video, how has the wireless industry responded to concerns about EMF exposure since 2011?

qAndA.answer: The video starts with anxiety and concern, transitions to tension and skepticism, and ends with frustration and hopelessness. The Secretary-General's dismissive attitude and repeated claims of ignorance contribute to the increasingly negative mood.
qAndA.question: What is the overall mood of the video?

activities.description: Claire Edwards begins speaking, addressing the UN Secretary-General.
She describes the exposure of UN staff at the Vienna International Center to high levels of electromagnetic radiation (EMF).
She cites specific data about the levels of exposure.
She mentions a Professor Olle Johansson's research on EMF dangers.
She speaks about documented studies showing harmful effects of EMFs.
She expresses concern about a potential global health catastrophe.
She urges the Secretary-General to remove EMF-emitting devices and halt the rollout of 5G.

characterInteraction.description: Claire Edwards is directly addressing the Secretary-General in a formal and urgent manner.

scenes.contextualRelevance: The speech suggests a possible cover-up or downplaying of EMF dangers by authorities.

narrativeProgression.description: This scene establishes the problem (EMF exposure) and the urgency for action.
Claire Edwards reveals the dangerous EMF exposure levels at the Vienna International Center.
She highlights the possibility of a global health catastrophe due to EMFs.
Claire Edwards calls for immediate action from the UN Secretary-General.

scenes.title: Scene 1: Claire Edwards' Address

videoEditingDetails.description: The video opens with the United Nations logo on a blue background.
Transition to a close-up shot of Claire Edwards speaking. Her name and title are displayed on screen.
Text overlays appear on screen, displaying the numerical figures of EMF exposure levels.
A screenshot of the website 'www.5Gspaceappeal.org' appears on screen for a few seconds.

activities.description: The UN Secretary-General responds to Claire Edwards, claiming ignorance on the issue.
Claire Edwards further explains the specific sources of EMF exposure within the UN buildings.
The Secretary-General jokes about having the same devices in his house, eliciting laughter from the audience.
He promises to raise the issue with the World Health Organization (WHO).
Claire Edwards stresses the opportunity for the UN to research the impact of EMF exposure on their own staff.
She points out that the metal-walled building exacerbates the situation, trapping the radiation.
She urges the Secretary-General to stop the rollout of 5G immediately.

characterInteraction.description: There is a clear power dynamic between Claire Edwards and Antonio Guterres. Claire Edwards is pleading for action, while the Secretary-General appears dismissive and evasive.

scenes.contextualRelevance: The Secretary-General's repeated claims of ignorance and his lighthearted response suggest a potential unwillingness to address the issue seriously.

keyMoments.changeDescription: The Secretary-General's joke about having the devices in his own home briefly shifts the mood from tense to humorous, evident in the audience's laughter.

narrativeProgression.description: This scene showcases the conflict between Claire Edwards' urgent call for action and the Secretary-General's apparent lack of concern and knowledge.
The Secretary-General makes his first claim of ignorance about the EMF issue.
The Secretary-General jokes about the issue, seeming to dismiss its seriousness.
The Secretary-General promises to raise the issue with the WHO.
Claire Edwards suggests using the UN staff's medical records to study the effects of EMF exposure.

scenes.thematicElements: EMF exposure, potential health risks, 5G technology, organizational responsibility, government accountability, skepticism towards authority.
scenes.title: Scene 2: UN Secretary-General's Response

videoEditingDetails.description: The camera angle widens to show the entire conference room and the audience.
Transition back to a close-up shot of Claire Edwards.
Transition to a shot of Antonio Guterres responding to Claire Edwards.
Transition back to a close-up shot of Claire Edwards.

activities.description: The Secretary-General makes multiple claims of ignorance regarding the EMF issue.
He acknowledges putting those devices in his own house.

characterInteraction.description: The Secretary-General is interacting with the audience, but his dismissive and uninformed responses suggest a lack of genuine engagement with their concerns.

scenes.contextualRelevance: The scene implies a potential deliberate ignorance or suppression of information about EMF dangers within the UN, possibly due to lobbying and pressure from the wireless industry.

narrativeProgression.description: This scene underscores the apparent disconnect between scientific evidence and the Secretary-General's awareness of the EMF issue.
The Secretary-General makes multiple claims of ignorance, raising questions about the awareness of the UN regarding EMF risks.
Documents and quotes from WHO reports are shown, contradicting the Secretary-General's assertions of ignorance and demonstrating a long-standing awareness of the issue within the UN.

scenes.thematicElements: EMF exposure, potential health risks, 5G technology, scientific evidence, government accountability, denial, corporate influence.
scenes.title: Scene 3: Disconnection Between Evidence and Awareness

videoEditingDetails.description: The camera focuses on Antonio Guterres.
Cut to text explaining that for 20 years, wireless radiation has been researched by the WHO.
Cut to text from a 2002 WHO report stating that RF and ELF exposure may be hazardous and that prudent avoidance is recommended.
Cut to text stating that by 2011, the WHO classified wireless as a group 2B carcinogen and a quote from the WHO IARC Director.
Cut to text stating that the wireless industry has greatly stepped up lobbying, interference and subversion.

activities.description: Antonio Guterres again claims ignorance on EMF danger, but promises to look into it.
Claire Edwards suggests everybody look into the issue, particularly 5G.

characterInteraction.description: Claire Edwards is visibly frustrated by the Secretary-General's lack of response and understanding.

scenes.contextualRelevance: The final text message serves as a warning and implies a potential legal pursuit of the UN and its officials for their negligence regarding EMF dangers.

keyMoments.changeDescription: The shift to a static TV screen and the final text message marks a significant change in mood, transitioning from frustration to a feeling of hopelessness and finality.

narrativeProgression.description: This scene concludes with a sense of resignation and emphasizes the lack of immediate action from the Secretary-General.
The Secretary-General admits his ignorance again.
The final text message highlights the potential legal ramifications for the Secretary-General and UN officials, implying their accountability for inaction.

scenes.thematicElements: EMF exposure, potential health risks, 5G technology, government accountability, inaction, criminal negligence.
scenes.title: Scene 4: Conclusion and Call to Action

videoEditingDetails.description: Cut to the United Nations logo on a blue background, followed by a static TV screen with red circle animation and text stating that Antonio Guterres has been notified of the facts and he and all other officials can now be held to account for criminal negligence, after which the video ends with a color bars test pattern.

climax.description: The presentation of documented evidence contradicting the Secretary-General's claims of ignorance.

storylines.description: The video presents a narrative story, highlighting the conflict between Claire Edwards' urgent warnings and the Secretary-General's apparent disregard for the issue.

timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Mr Secretary General, you and staff have repeatedly been told that they are the most important
resource of this organization. Since December 2015, the staff here at the Vienna International
Centre have been exposed to off-the-scale electromagnetic radiation from Wi-Fi and mobile
phone boosters installed on very low ceilings throughout the buildings. Current public exposure
levels are at least one quintillion, that's 18 zeroes, one quintillion times above natural
background radiation, according to Professor Oli Johansson of the Caroleanske Institute in Sweden.
The highly dangerous biological effects of EMFs have been documented by thousands of studies
since 1932, indicating that we may be facing a global health catastrophe, orders of magnitude
worse than those caused by tobacco and cigarettes. Mr Secretary General, on the basis of the
precautionary principle, I urge you to have these EMF emitting devices removed immediately from
these buildings and to call a halt to any rollout of 5G at UN duty stations because 5G is designed
to deliver concentrated and focused electromagnetic radiation in excess of 100 times current levels
in the same way as do directed energy weapons. In line with the UN guiding principles on
business and human rights to protect, respect and remedy, 5G technologies must be subjected to an
independent health and safety assessment before they are launched anywhere in the world.
There is currently an international appeal signed by 237 EMF scientists from 41 nations
urging the UN and particularly the WHO to exert strong leadership in fostering the development
of more protective EMF guidelines, encouraging precautionary measures and educating the public
about the considerable health risks, particularly the risks to children and fetal development.
Mr Secretary General, I think we have a unique opportunity here at the UN office at Vienna.

youtube_description:
Disclosure about 5G — and its unprecedented risk for humanity — is occurring within the United Nations. 

This is thanks to longtime UN staff member and whistle-blower Claire Edwards, who recently contacted me with this powerful story which touches all of humanity and our shared future. It is time we do what we are here to do. -Josh del Sol Beaulieu

Read Claire's powerful disclosure & full story:
https://takebackyourpower.net/un-staff-member-5g-is-war-on-humanity
